question: Which of the following compounds having the molecular formula C₂H is derived from the hydride of acetylene?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ethynyl**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ethynyl compounds** having the molecular formula** C2H **is derived from the hydride of acetylene.
 
• Ethynyl, characterized as a terminal acetylenic compound and an organic radical, serves as a functional group in organic chemistry with the formula −C≡CH.
 
• The ethynyl radical, with the chemical formula C≡CH, is a straightforward molecule found abundantly in the interstellar medium but is not naturally occurring on Earth.
 
• Acetylene, a hydrocarbon and the simplest alkyne, exists as a colorless gas extensively employed as both a fuel and a fundamental chemical building block.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Propargyl** serves as a functional group in organic chemistry, featuring the structure CH≡C−CH₂.
 
• It is an** alkyl group** derived from propyne. **Vinyl **is a chemical compound obtained from ethylene and chlorine. Widely recognized as the world's most versatile plastic, it finds application in various products including food wrap, flooring, siding, wall covering, and auto body parts.
 
• In organic chemistry, an **allyl group **is a substituent with the structural formula −CH₂−HC=CH₂. This name is derived from Allium sativum, the scientific name for garlic.
